keyFindings.description: The PR adds changed, ancestors and thread_logins to @legion/contracts' zod event schemas (dispatch-api.ts:2750-2752 and the ask, comment and message schemas), which claude-envoy inlines into its committed dist/dispatch.js, dist/envoy-channel.js and dist/session-hook.js, but did not rebuild them. claude-envoy's check-dist fails at 27152a78 (job 122310200662: 'generated files are stale (dist/dispatch.js, dist/envoy-channel.js, dist/session-hook.js)'), and I reproduced it in the workspace on Bun 1.3.14. A fresh build differs from the committed dist only by those optional fields. The job runs on any change under packages/contracts (envoy-and-contracts.yaml claude_plugin filter), so merging leaves the stale bundle on main and every later contracts or claude-envoy PR red. Fix: cd packages/claude-envoy && bun run build, commit dist/.
